notes_for_editor: Only the tower list names a tower here; the Mapcarta page describes a cliff (a landform), not a tower, so it is cited for place context only. The 'topo 1954' note is unexplained on the list, so the story quotes it without interpreting it. Not on the NHLR Georgia list (29 registered lookouts) or the FFLOS Georgia former-sites list (2 entries). Brief elevation_m 3.0 assumes the list's 10 is feet; the page prints no unit, so the story omits elevation. Status and access stay unknown; no source describes the site today.
